text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature wasn't quite able to pull off 
the win. Yet, she reflected on the race 
with joy, happy that she had given her 
absolute all to answer the fans' 
expectations.

To become even stronger, she tries to pry 
the secret of success from Mejiro McQueen 
and Mejiro Ryan.

Pleased by Nice Nature's question, the two 
promised to properly answer her another 
day.

Giving a glimpse of new growth on the 
horizon... Nice Nature sets her sights on 
her next goal, the Takarazuka Kinen.
